notes:
DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: none; the card's family-config GymnasiumDriver shape fits the confirmed entry symbol matterix.envs:MatterixBaseEnv (source/matterix/matterix/envs/matterix_base_env.py:48), a Gymnasium environment. The package serves the card's first registered task, Matterix-Test-Beakers-Franka-v1 (source/matterix_tasks/matterix_tasks/test_dev_tasks/__init__.py:15-22). NOT COVERED: the upstream environment itself was never imported or run. It needs Isaac Sim 5.0, Isaac Lab 3.0, a GPU and a cfg object built by isaaclab_tasks.utils.parse_env_cfg before gym.make(task, cfg=...) (README.md:27-39, scripts/random_agent.py:60-64), none of which exists where the gate runs. The GymnasiumDriver sim path calls gym.make(env_id) without a cfg, so it would fail on this upstream registration; a real deployment needs a cfg-aware factory, which this package does not provide, and that path was not run. The fake backend is a kinematic stand-in: it matches the policy group shape (two batched end-effector 3-vectors, ee_pos_robot and ee_pos_robot2) and the 16-value action shape of the two Franka arms, but it models no Isaac Sim, PhysX, assets, contacts, gravity, actuators or sensors; its reset jitter, action gain, fixed reward 0 and 360-step truncation are placeholders from the upstream defaults, not facts or limits. Its observation values are not the upstream task's values. Snapshot/restore is not offered because MatterixBaseEnv defines no get_state/set_state. No hardware path exists and none was run. Warnings left by the gate and their reasons: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the bridge only buffers the seed for the next reset; it makes no native call), G8.SAFE014_NOT_APPLICABLE (the upstream action space is Box(-inf, inf) at matterix_base_env.py:437, so no action bound exists to probe and the driver must not invent one), and G8.NO_UNIT x4 for ticks, the two seed inputs and action.values[*] (simulator inputs with no catalogue unit; the driver is simulated at R0). G4 had no REF_VALUE or REF_BINARY warnings. The clone at commit 687e2cef294f00e86dbb32173fefd93b50e5107f was read only and stays unmodified.
